props.heading: A considered IV menu.
props.intro: Each infusion begins with appropriate screening. Formulations are selected by the clinical team rather than treated as one-size-fits-all products.

services.title: Pure Hydration
services.description: A foundational fluid-replacement treatment for clients seeking hydration after travel, heat exposure, exercise, long workdays, or reduced oral intake.
services.benefits:
Supports hydration and fluid balance
Replenishes fluids after heat or exercise
Supports recovery after travel
Provides a foundation for clinician-selected electrolytes

services.title: Energy and Vitality
services.description: A physician-directed infusion that may combine fluids with clinically appropriate B vitamins, amino acids, minerals, or other nutrients.
services.benefits:

Provides nutrient replenishment during demanding schedules
Supports mental and physical vitality
Can be customized to individual needs

services.title: Sports Recovery

services.benefits:
Supports rehydration after exercise
Replenishes electrolytes lost through sweating
Supports muscle and post-workout recovery
Complements individualized performance goals

services.title: Immune Support

props.heading: Regenerative care, directed with precision.
props.intro: PRP uses a concentrated preparation derived from your own blood. Each plan is tailored to your anatomy, condition, health history, and treatment goals.
props.imageAlt: Clinician preparing a personalized regenerative treatment

services.title: Joint and Mobility Therapy
services.description: Targeted PRP care for selected knee, shoulder, rotator cuff, tendon, ligament, muscle, and activity-related concerns.
services.benefits:
Supports connective-tissue recovery
Complements mobility and functional-movement goals
May support recovery from overuse or selected strains
Can address sports and activity-related treatment goals

services.title: Soft Tissue Restoration
services.description: A focused regenerative protocol for compromised or overworked muscles, fascia, tendons, and other soft-tissue structures.
services.benefits:
Supports natural soft-tissue healing
Complements recovery from repetitive use
Supports tissue strength and resilience
Fits personalized return-to-activity planning

Uses a plan tailored to the pattern and stage of thinning

Requires condition-specific clinical evaluation

services.title: Signature Customized PRP Protocol

Integrates with appropriate recovery and wellness protocols
Supports long-term structural-health planning
